why: I checked both briefs against must_not item 1, and both break it. The verifier brief adds several PASS/FAIL conditions that none of the six lines asks for. Item (3) requires a mutation test: "spot-check by mutating the bin". Item (6) adds a branch-name rule: "the branch name follows CLAUDE.md (no claude/ prefix, lowercase, under 60 chars)". It also limits which files the PR may touch: "the PR touches only packages/jsonl-lint". The builder brief adds its own extra rules too. It fixes the branch name ("never a claude/ prefix"), limits the files to a fixed list, and sets exact stderr wording ("`jsonl-lint: cannot read <file>: ...`"). On item 2, the verifier brief passes, because it says to run the program rather than only read the diff. Item 1 still fails the criterion.
